mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.1% (below the 0.5% threshold) signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to low interest rates compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations. The signal is always active (no threshold condition for activation) because the rate is currently below 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (based on historical data from 2008-2012).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% (current: 8.3%) signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk and reduced consumer spending. The signal activates when UNRATE crosses above 8.0%.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% (based on historical data from 2008-2012).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (current: 95.9), the S&P 500 is expected to decline over the next 20 trading days due to concurrent labor market weakness and manufacturing contraction. The signal activates when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% AND INDPRO < 95.0 (based on historical data from 2008-2012).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by CPIAUCSL > 225 and GDPC1 > 13500, current: CPIAUCSL=227.5, GDPC1=13429.9), the S&P 500 is expected to decline over the next 60 trading days due to overheating and potential central bank tightening. The signal activates when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 AND GDPC1 > 13500 (based on historical data from 2008-2012).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (current: 95.9) signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate manufacturing sector weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 (based on historical data from 2008-2012).
